fusions.name: Tamped Carcass
fusions.desc: Smashes the nearest body within 9 tiles into a burst of spores that deals 28 damage plus 8% of that body's maximum health to everything within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Settling Slam
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A crushing blow that deals 26 damage, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Compost Press
fusions.desc: Restores 22 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Softening Rot
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 12%.
